New Systems & Achievements Update

Final Update After the Comic Exhibition

New Content

Adventure Mode – Learn the basics of gameplay through this mode.

Goblin King – Challenge a slightly more difficult AI opponent.

Achievement System – Unlock achievements by completing specific challenges.

Balance & Optimization Adjustments

Millennium Zombie Cocoon: HP increased from 3 → 4

Magic Wand “Memory Unlock!”: Jellyfish can only summon up to 4

Fried Egg Jellyfish: ATK increased from 0 → 1

Gunslinger Dan Yakushiji: Removed “Rebirth”; “Cover Shot” now deals +1 additional damage

BOSS Ku: Mana cost increased from 6 → 7; removed “Boss Ku Aura”

Elf Shirayuki Tsuki: ATK decreased from 4 → 3

Xin Xili Can Save Lives: Mana cost increased from 2 → 3; effect changed to affect all allied units

notes.title: Update Preview
notes.notes:
With the conclusion of the event, Virtual Frenzy – Nexus Corps, the mission of this namesake card game has also come to an end.

However, as the developer, I hope it will be more than just an event-exclusive game — something players can still revisit and enjoy as a single-player experience from time to time.

To enhance its playability, the final version will include the following features:
[olist]
Goblin King – In AI battles, you can challenge the Goblin King (with a unique AI deck).

Adventure Mode – Offers tutorials and simple challenges.

Achievement System – Complete specific challenges to unlock Steam achievements.
[/olist]
Some features and card balance issues previously mentioned in player feedback will also be addressed in future updates, including cloud save support.
